items.claim: The `gha-update` dependency group contains `gha-update` conditioned on `python_full_version >= "3.13"`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The marker is python_full_version >= '3.12', not 3.13.

items.claim: In `Serializer.dumps` the payload is wrapped as `self.dump_payload(want_bytes(obj))`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The code is `payload = want_bytes(self.dump_payload(obj))`, with want_bytes applied to the dumped payload, not to obj.

items.claim: `URLSafeSerializerMixin.load_payload` delegates to `super().load_payload(json)`, the base `Serializer.load_payload`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The mixin ends with `return super().load_payload(json, *args, **kwargs)`, delegating to Serializer.load_payload.

items.claim: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` enables the hooks `ruff` and `black`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The hooks are ruff and ruff-format; black is not present.

items.claim: `Signer` has a `secret_keys` attribute of type `list[bytes]`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: secret_keys is annotated as list[bytes].

items.claim: `want_bytes` in encoding.py encodes text as UTF-8 with `errors='strict'`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: want_bytes defaults to encoding='utf-8' and errors='strict' and encodes str with those.

items.claim: `Signer.verify_signature` loops over `reversed(self.secret_keys)`, derives a key for each, and returns `True` on the first algorithm match, otherwise `False`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: verify_signature iterates `reversed(self.secret_keys)`, derives a key per secret, returns True on the first match else False.

items.claim: `Serializer.__init__` allows `salt=None`, deferring the decision to the `Signer`'s own default.
items.label: supported
items.reason: If salt is None it is left as None with the comment that the signer's default is used.

items.claim: `_CompactJSON.loads('{"id":5,"name":"itsdangerous"}')` returns `{'id': 5, 'name': 'itsdangerous'}`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: _CompactJSON.loads simply calls json.loads, which parses 5 as an int.

items.claim: When `signer_kwargs=None` is passed, `Serializer.__init__` sets it to `{}`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `self.signer_kwargs: dict[str, t.Any] = signer_kwargs or {}` yields {} when None.

items.claim: `_CompactJSON.loads('{"id":5,"name":"itsdangerous"}')` returns `{'id': '5', 'name': 'itsdangerous'}`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: json.loads yields the integer 5, not the string '5'.

items.claim: `Serializer.__init__` coerces `salt=None` to the default `b'itsdangerous.Serializer'` before storing it.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: salt=None is stored as None; no default b'itsdangerous.Serializer' coercion happens in Serializer.__init__.

items.claim: `Signer.derive_key` raises `ValueError` for an unknown key derivation method.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: derive_key raises TypeError for an unknown derivation method.

items.claim: The tests workflow's typing job sets `python-version-file: .python-version`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The typing job uses python-version-file: pyproject.toml.

items.claim: When `signer=None` is passed, `Serializer.__init__` uses the class default signer, which for the plain serializer is `Signer`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: default_signer is Signer and __init__ falls back to it when signer is None.

items.claim: `Signer` has a `secret_keys` attribute of type `tuple[bytes, ...]`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: secret_keys is a list[bytes], not a tuple.

items.claim: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` enables the hooks `ruff` and `ruff-format`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The ruff repo hooks listed are ruff and ruff-format.

items.claim: `want_bytes` in encoding.py encodes text as UTF-8 with `errors='ignore'`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: want_bytes' default errors value is 'strict', not 'ignore'.

items.claim: `Signer.unsign` raises `BadSignature` with the message "Separator b'.' missing from value" when the separator is absent.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The message is f"No {self.sep!r} found in value", not "Separator ... missing from value".

items.claim: `docs/conf.py` enables the extensions `sphinx.ext.autodoc`, `sphinx.ext.napoleon`, `sphinx.ext.intersphinx`, `sphinxcontrib.log_cabinet`, and `pallets_sphinx_themes`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The extensions include sphinx.ext.extlinks, not sphinx.ext.napoleon.

items.claim: The `gha-update` dependency group contains `gha-update` conditioned on `python_full_version >= "3.12"`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: gha-update group has marker python_full_version >= '3.12'.

items.claim: The `salt` parameter of `Signer` is required.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: salt has a default of b"itsdangerous.Signer".

items.claim: `docs/conf.py` enables the extensions `sphinx.ext.autodoc`, `sphinx.ext.extlinks`, `sphinx.ext.intersphinx`, `sphinxcontrib.log_cabinet`, and `pallets_sphinx_themes`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Those are exactly the five extensions listed.

items.claim: `Signer.verify_signature` loops over `self.secret_keys` in order, derives a key for each, and returns `True` on the first algorithm match, otherwise `False`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The loop iterates over `reversed(self.secret_keys)`, i.e. newest first, not in list order.

items.claim: In `Serializer.dumps` the payload is wrapped as `want_bytes(self.dump_payload(obj))`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: dumps contains exactly `payload = want_bytes(self.dump_payload(obj))`.

items.claim: `Signer` supports the key derivation methods `concat`, `django-concat`, `hmac`, and `none`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: derive_key handles concat, django-concat, hmac, and none.

items.claim: The `secret_key` parameter of `Signer` is required.
items.label: supported
items.reason: secret_key is the first positional parameter without a default.

items.claim: The tests workflow's typing job sets `python-version-file: pyproject.toml`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The typing job sets python-version-file: pyproject.toml.

items.claim: The GitHub Actions workflow `publish.yaml` is triggered by pushes to the `main` branch and contains `build`, `create-release`, and `publish-pypi` jobs.
items.label: contradicted

items.claim: `Signer.unsign` raises `BadSignature` with the message "No b'.' found in value" when the separator is absent.
items.label: supported
items.reason: With sep b'.', the f-string produces "No b'.' found in value".

items.claim: `Signer` supports the key derivation methods `concat`, `django-concat`, `hmac`, and `pbkdf2`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: There is no pbkdf2 derivation; the fourth option is none.

items.claim: `URLSafeSerializerMixin.load_payload` delegates to `self.serializer.loads(json)`, bypassing the base `Serializer.load_payload`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: It calls super().load_payload(json, ...) rather than self.serializer.loads directly.

items.claim: The project declares `requires-python = ">=3.9"` in pyproject.toml.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: requires-python is ">=3.10".

items.claim: `HMACAlgorithm.get_signature` calls `hmac.new(key, msg=value, digestmod=self.digest_method)` and returns `mac.hexdigest()`.
items.label: contradicted

items.claim: When `signer=None` is passed, `Serializer.__init__` uses the class default signer, which for the plain serializer is `TimestampSigner`.
items.label: contradicted

items.label: supported

items.claim: `HMACAlgorithm.get_signature` calls `hmac.new(key, msg=value, digestmod=self.digest_method)` and returns `mac.digest()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The method builds hmac.new(key, msg=value, digestmod=self.digest_method) and returns mac.digest().

items.claim: When `signer_kwargs=None` is passed, `Serializer.__init__` sets it to `dict(salt=self.salt)`.
items.label: contradicted
